summary: ST-02 decomposes the creature framework into three bounded, independently testable leaves. WI-02a owns the headless simulation runtime (one behavior, one subsystem: creature simulation - steering, WorldSignalBus senses, generic state machine, bespoke hook, offscreen throttling) with focused node unit tests; WI-02b owns the procedural 2.5D renderers (one subsystem: rendering, pure read-only adapter) with a focused browser check; WI-02c owns the ecology/cross-species illusion (two subsystems: creature simulation + world signal bus) as the dependent integration leaf. Dependency order is correct and acyclic: WI-02a (none) -> WI-02b (WI-02a) -> WI-02c (WI-02a, WI-02b); no leaf depends on an ancestor or descendant. All three parent criteria (AC-cf-core, AC-cf-render, AC-cf-ecology) are retained verbatim by exactly one child each, so the union covers every parent criterion. Cross-child proof is explicitly assigned to the dependent WI-02c (node scenario for schools and cross-species reactions plus the visible-schools browser check), and the placeholder organisms are consistently labeled as framework fixtures. No roster/secret content is pulled in; no ECS framework; rendering keeps no gameplay rules; section 34 performance constraints are carried into each leaf. No empty story, no circular dependency, no contradictory boundaries, and the scope inventory supports the claimed decomposition. Leaf-level limits are satisfied by each child; story-level counts are not required to be leaf-sized.
